steps.title: Ihram
steps.subtitle: Enter the state of consecration
steps.description: The first step of Umrah is to enter the state of Ihram before crossing the Miqat.

preparation: Trim nails and remove unwanted hair
Women: Wear modest dress (no specific color required)
procedure: Observe all Ihram restrictions until completing Umrah

duas.translation: Here I am, O Allah, for Umrah.

duas.arabic: لَبَّيْكَ اللَّهُمَّ لَبَّيْكَ، لَبَّيْكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ لَبَّيْكَ
duas.transliteration: Labbayk Allahumma Labbayk, Labbayka Laa Shareeka Laka Labbayk
duas.translation: Here I am, O Allah, here I am. Here I am, You have no partner, here I am.

restrictions: Men: No covered headwear, no stitched garments
Women: No face veil (niqab) or gloves, though can cover face when men are nearby
tips: Enter Ihram at or before Miqat based on your location
For those in Makkah: Ihram from Masjid Aisha (Tan'im)
Keep money belt for important documents

steps.title: Tawaf
steps.subtitle: Circumambulate the Kaaba
steps.description: Circle the Kaaba seven times counterclockwise as an act of worship.

preparation: Enter Masjid al-Haram with right foot
First sight of Kaaba - make heartfelt dua
Men: Uncover right shoulder (Idtiba) for Tawaf
procedure: Kiss/touch Black Stone if possible, otherwise point to it
Begin walking counterclockwise, keeping Kaaba on your left
Men: Walk briskly (Raml) during first 3 circuits
Touch Yemeni corner if possible without causing harm
Between Yemeni corner and Black Stone, recite: "Rabbana atina..."
Pray 2 Rakah Salah near Maqam Ibrahim

duas.translation: In the name of Allah, Allah is the Greatest.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan waqina adhaban-nar
duas.translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and save us from the punishment of the Fire.

tips: Don't harm others to kiss Black Stone
If you lose count, assume the lower number
Wheelchairs available for those who need

steps.title: Sa'i
steps.subtitle: Walk between Safa and Marwah
steps.description: Walk seven times between the hills of Safa and Marwah, commemorating Hajar's search for water.

procedure: Climb Safa hill (or stand at base if crowded)
Recite: "Indeed, Safa and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah"
Raise hands and make dua (3 times)
Men: Jog between the green markers
Women: Walk at normal pace throughout
Reach Marwah, face Kaaba, raise hands and make dua
This completes one lap (Safa to Marwah = 1)

duas.arabic: إِنَّ الصَّفَا وَالْمَرْوَةَ مِن شَعَآئِرِ اللَّهِ
duas.translation: Indeed, Safa and Marwah are among the symbols of Allah.

duas.arabic: اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيكَ لَهُ
duas.transliteration: Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar Allahu Akbar, La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah
duas.translation: Allah is the Greatest (3x), there is no deity but Allah alone with no partner.

tips: Pace yourself - it's about 450m each way
Can rest between laps if needed

steps.title: Halq or Taqsir
steps.subtitle: Cut or shave hair
steps.description: The final step of Umrah - shaving or trimming the hair.

procedure: 2. Taqsir (trimming) - at least 1-2 cm from all over head
Women: Trim fingertip length (about 1-2 cm) from end of hair

duas.translation: O Allah, forgive those who shave and those who trim.

tips: Barbers work very quickly during busy times
Women can trim in hotel room
After this, you can wear normal clothes and use perfume
Umrah is now complete - may Allah accept it

steps.title: After Umrah
steps.subtitle: Recommended acts
steps.description: Maximize your time in the blessed city.

procedure: Pray in Masjid al-Haram (100,000 times reward)
Perform Tawaf al-Wida before leaving Makkah
tips: Make dua for yourself and all Muslims
